reason: The README clearly describes a persistent Markdown-based memory plugin that reads, writes, summarizes, and injects user and workspace memories across sessions.

summaries.zh: 一个将用户级和工作区级记忆持久化为可编辑 Markdown 文件，并在会话间自动读取、记录和注入上下文的插件。
summaries.en: A plugin that persists user and workspace memories as editable Markdown files and automatically reads, records, and injects them across sessions.

capabilities: Reads user-level and workspace-level Markdown memory files
Writes and appends memory notes and daily logs to local files
Injects stored memory into conversation system prompts
Optionally summarizes conversation increments using an LLM
Deletes matching memory entries after a preview and user confirmation
